headline: Cabrera's 10th-inning homer walks off Cubs
recap: The Phillies beat the Chicago Cubs 2-1 in 10 innings at Citizens Bank Park. Chicago had taken a 1-0 lead in the top of the fifth on a Javier Baez solo home run off Nick Pivetta. The Phillies tied it in the sixth on a Cesar Hernandez RBI single that scored Roman Quinn, and the game stayed knotted at 1-1 until Asdrubal Cabrera led off the bottom of the tenth with a solo home run, his 21st of the season, off Cubs reliever Steve Cishek to win it.

Pivetta started for Philadelphia and allowed one run on five hits over five innings, walking three and striking out six. Cubs starter Jose Quintana went six innings, giving up one run on three hits with seven strikeouts and a walk.

The Phillies' bullpen held Chicago scoreless the rest of the way: Victor Arano, Adam Morgan, Seranthony Dominguez and Hector Neris combined for four and two-thirds innings before Pat Neshek worked a scoreless tenth to pick up the win. Cishek took the loss.
